ATU Local 1181 represents bus operators and mechanics who work for the MTA Bus division, formerly Command Bus Service in Brooklyn’s Spring Creek, and paratransit operators and Yellow School Bus drivers and escorts. Statewide, the ATU represents more than 25,000 hard-working transit workers throughout ATU cities including Albany, Binghamton, Buffalo, New York City, Rochester, and Syracuse.
